_documentation: selected_token_oracle contains the post-prefill single-token decode inputs and capture settings used by single_token_decode_oracle_test.
prompt_matched_oracle contains full-prompt parity evidence and contract strings; it is intentionally separate from the selected-token oracle surface.
model_config contains structural model metadata shared by the fixture and should not be read as token-level oracle evidence.

selected_token_oracle._documentation: Single-token oracle metadata for zeroed-state decode validation. This section is the selected-token evidence surface, not the prompt-matched vLLM oracle.

prompt_matched_oracle._documentation: Prompt-matched parity metadata for the full 40-token short_chat prompt. These values are vLLM ground truth and related parity contracts, not selected-token decode expectations.

model_config._documentation: Structural model configuration and shared fixture shape metadata.

notes: single_token mode runs one token from scratch with zeroed cache/state.
prefix_prefill mode runs a short prompt prefix from scratch and can stop after an early capture layer to keep fixture generation practical.
Prompt-matched vLLM oracle for the full 40-token short_chat prompt now begins with token 4268 and continues with the recorded 16-token sequence above.
Attention, Mamba, and MoE blocks mirror the current correctness-first runtime contracts already used by the layer-level oracle fixtures.
Routed and shared NVFP4 runtime tensor scales use the corrected effective contract: input_scale * weight_scale_2.
Captured per-layer outputs are intended for the composed registry-backed forward-path validation.
Captured Mamba layers also include final conv/SSM state snapshots for decode-boundary localization.
